name: leta
description: Leta (LSP Enabled Tools for Agents) is a command line LSP client. It searches for symbols across large code bases with regular expressions, prints full function and method bodies, finds references, implementations, subtypes, call hierarchies, and performs semantic refactoring such as renaming symbols across the entire code base.

conventions.line_numbers: All line numbers are 1-based unless stated otherwise.
conventions.ranges: Line ranges are inclusive. END defaults to START for commands that take an optional END.
conventions.text_input: Commands that accept --body and --file read stdin when neither is provided and stdin is not a terminal. --file '-' also reads stdin. --body conflicts with --file.
conventions.json_output: The global --json flag prints the command's RPC result object as pretty JSON. Commands that require no daemon do not support it.
conventions.type_expressions: Types in params and results use simple expressions: string, number, boolean, Name, Name[], map<string,Name>, Name|null. 'x|null' means the field may be absent or null.
conventions.required: A param marked required must be present in the request. Optional params may be omitted and then take their default.
conventions.workspace_root: Absolute path to a workspace root previously registered with `leta workspace add`.

symbol_kind.description: Symbol kinds as reported by LSP servers. Accepted case-insensitively by --kind.

calls_mode.description: Call hierarchy direction. Chosen automatically by the CLI: both --from and --to gives 'path', only --from gives 'outgoing', only --to gives 'incoming'.

insert_position.description: Where to insert new source relative to the target symbol.

commands.name: grep
commands.about: Search for symbols matching a regex pattern.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.description: Regex pattern to match against symbol names

notes: Only symbol names declared in the workspace are searched, never file contents.
Matching is case-insensitive unless -C/--case-sensitive is given.
Prints a warning when the pattern contains a space, since leta grep is not a text search.
Streams results as they are found unless --json or --profile is used.

commands.name: files
commands.about: Show source file tree with symbol and line counts.
notes: Without PATH the workspace is resolved from the current directory. With PATH the workspace is resolved from that path.
Directories such as .git and __pycache__ are excluded by default; -i re-includes a matching directory.
Streams the tree as it is built unless --json or --profile is used.

commands.name: read
commands.about: Print a file or line range with line numbers.

options.name: raw
options.description: Print selected lines without header or line numbers

notes: Reads files directly from disk; no daemon, workspace, or language server is required.
The file must be valid UTF-8; binary files are rejected.
Passing a directory produces an error suggesting `leta files`.
Result fields: path, start_line, end_line, total_lines, content, truncated, next_start_line.

commands.name: show
commands.about: Print the definition of a symbol.
notes: Symbol formats: `Name`, `Parent.Name`, `path:Name`, `path:Parent.Name`.
Ambiguous symbols produce a disambiguation list on stderr; qualify the symbol to disambiguate.

commands.name: refs
commands.about: Find all references to a symbol.

commands.name: calls
commands.about: Show call hierarchy for a symbol.
notes: At least one of --from or --to must be specified.
--from only: outgoing calls. --to only: incoming calls. Both: shortest call path between them.

commands.name: graph
commands.about: Show workspace call graph.

options.name: include_orphans
options.description: Include symbols with no callers or callees

options.name: depth
options.description: Call tree depth from roots (0 = roots only, 1 = roots + direct callees). Omit for all depths

notes: The full graph is shown by default; --depth limits each tree client-side after the full graph is returned.
Test files are excluded unless --include-tests is given.
Trees are rooted at entry points (functions with no callers).

commands.name: implementations
commands.about: Find implementations of an interface or abstract method.

commands.name: supertypes
commands.about: Find direct supertypes of a type.

commands.name: subtypes
commands.about: Find direct subtypes of a type.

commands.name: declaration
commands.about: Find declaration of a symbol.

commands.name: rename
commands.about: Rename a symbol across the workspace.
notes: Updates all references to the symbol across the workspace.

commands.name: replace
commands.about: Replace a symbol definition with new contents from stdin or a file.

options.name: file
options.description: Read replacement from FILE ('-' reads stdin)

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

notes: The replacement is re-indented to match the original symbol.
Function and method signatures are validated unless --no-check-signature is given.

commands.name: insert-before
commands.about: Insert new source immediately before a symbol.

options.name: file
options.description: Read text from FILE ('-' reads stdin)

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

notes: Text is re-indented to match the target symbol and inserted verbatim.
Include blank lines in the input if you want separation from surrounding code.
Sends RPC method `insert` with position `before`.

commands.name: insert-after
commands.about: Insert new source immediately after a symbol.

options.name: file
options.description: Read text from FILE ('-' reads stdin)

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

notes: Text is re-indented to match the target symbol and inserted verbatim.
Include blank lines in the input if you want separation from surrounding code.
Sends RPC method `insert` with position `after`.

commands.name: delete-lines
commands.about: Delete a range of lines within a file.

arguments.name: end
arguments.description: Last line to delete (defaults to START)

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

notes: Edits by line number instead of symbol name.
The workspace is resolved from the target file's path.

commands.name: insert-at-line
commands.about: Insert content at a given line in a file.

options.name: file
options.description: Read text from FILE ('-' reads stdin)

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

notes: Inserts before the given line; use line_count + 1 to append.
Text is inserted verbatim with no re-indentation.

commands.name: replace-lines
commands.about: Replace a range of lines within a file with new content.

arguments.name: end
arguments.description: Last line to replace (defaults to START)

options.name: file
options.description: Read text from FILE ('-' reads stdin)

options.name: dry_run
options.description: Show what would change without writing

notes: Edits by line number instead of symbol name.
Replacement text is inserted verbatim with no re-indentation.

commands.name: mv
commands.about: Move/rename a file and update all imports.
notes: OLD_PATH must already exist and is canonicalized.
NEW_PATH is resolved relative to the current directory and may not exist yet.

commands.name: workspace
commands.about: Manage workspaces.

subcommands.name: add
subcommands.about: Add a workspace for LSP operations.
notes: Without PATH, the workspace root is auto-detected from the current directory.
Prints 'Added workspace: <root>' or 'Workspace already added: <root>'.

subcommands.name: remove
subcommands.about: Remove a workspace and stop its language servers.

subcommands.name: restart
subcommands.about: Restart the language server for a workspace.

subcommands.name: info
subcommands.about: Show workspace info for current directory.
notes: Prints the resolved workspace root for the current directory.
Errors with 'No workspace found' when none is registered.

commands.name: daemon
commands.about: Manage the leta daemon.

subcommands.name: info

options.name: profile
options.description: Show startup and indexing profiling data

notes: This subcommand-level --profile shadows the global --profile flag.
Prints daemon PID, caches, workspaces, and optionally profiling data.

subcommands.name: restart
notes: Sends `shutdown` if the daemon is running, waits for the socket to disappear, then spawns a new daemon.

subcommands.name: start
notes: Spawns the leta-daemon process if it is not already running.
Prints 'Daemon already running' or 'Daemon started'.

subcommands.name: stop
notes: Prints 'Daemon is not running' when there is nothing to stop.
Prints 'Daemon stopped' after a successful shutdown request.

commands.name: config
commands.about: Print config file location and contents.
notes: Prints 'Config file: <path>', a blank line, then the config file contents.
Prints '(file does not exist, using defaults)' when the file is missing.

commands.name: help-all
commands.about: Print help for all commands.
notes: Prints main help followed by long help for every subcommand, separated by banner rules.

transport.response: For non-streaming requests: one JSON object. For streaming requests: one JSON object per line until a `done` or `error` message.

request.stream: boolean (default false; only honored by `grep` and `files`)
